answer: That makes last-minute recruitment useless, as the wharf edge has to exist before the case does. Because the river history dates every edge, the basalt audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 7 epochs of prior interaction to count. Honest users pay that once, farms 22 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
